text:
deploy-bot: publish failed for image redwood/service-api:staging -> account 123456789012/eu-west-1
error=ECR:PutImageDenied (policy prevents tag overwrite)
digest=sha256:9f8b7c4d... provenance_check=cosign:missing

sam: saw this alert. Is the new tag-protection policy live?

priya: yes, org policy 'no-tag-rewrite' enabled last night for prod+staging in eu. PutImage fails if tag exists with different digest.

diego: CI pushed two attempts? Build 4453 succeeded but retried, maybe double-push changed digest.

lena: logs show a previous push at 02:10 by `ci-runner/4453` with tag `staging` -> sha256:3b2a9a1e...
the failed push has sha256:9f8b7c4d... so it's a different digest.

sam: so we can't overwrite staging tag. Options: retag new digest to a fresh tag and update canary, or revert deployment to pinned digest.

priya: we should avoid a live change during the 10:00-11:00 PT release window. Can we do a canary to `staging-ci-4453` and keep `staging` pinned?

diego: yes, push alternative tag `ci-4453-9f8b` and create canary route. quick commands:
```
aws ecr put-image --repository-name service-api --image-tag ci-4453-9f8b --image-manifest '<manifest>'
cosign sign --key ksm:alias/redwood-ci ci-4453-9f8b
```

deploy-bot: rolling fallback available: previous pinned digest sha256:3b2a9a1e... is deployed as current staging canary.

lena: cosign failure note — the new KMS key rotated yesterday for CI signing; some runners didn't pick up the new alias, so provenance_check failed for 9f8b7c4d.

priya: ops, can KMS team confirm alias propagation? @ops-bot status?

ops-bot: KMS alias `alias/redwood-ci` rotation completed at 01:40 UTC, propagation to eu runtimes at 02:05 UTC. Some older runners cached creds.

sam: decision: don't attempt to overwrite `staging` tag now. Diego, push `ci-4453-9f8b`, sign with new key, then create canary route. We'll pin `staging` to sha256:3b2a9a1e... and schedule a retag+promote in the 13:00 PT change window if KMS issues are resolved.

lena: opened ticket #INFRA-3921 for CI runner credential refresh + automatic retry on cosign failure. also adding step to tag by digest (push by manifest + tag=ci-...) to avoid overwrite.

priya: update release notes: add small line "staging push deferred due to tag protection policy; canary using ephemeral tag". I can add after the window.

sam: ok. I'll run the rollback to pinned digest to be safe:
`deploybot rollback service-api --to-digest sha256:3b2a9a1e... --reason "publish_denied_tag_protect"`

deploy-bot: rollback scheduled at 1712350200. Notify if problems.

diego: pushing `ci-4453-9f8b` now.

lena: thanks — follow-up: will we add a CI flag to prefer `--push-by-digest`? That would be ideal to avoid tag collisions.

priya: agreed. We'll follow up in infra sync. closing for now :thumbsup:
